# Lost item replacement charges

An item is declared lost 14 days after its overdue fine reaches the accrual
ceiling, or immediately when the borrower reports it lost. The replacement
charge is the catalogue list price recorded on the item record, plus a
processing charge of 5.00.

Where no list price is recorded, a default replacement charge applies by format:

- hardback: 30.00
- paperback: 15.00
- periodical issue: 6.00
- map sheet: 20.00

A replacement charge is reversed in full if the item is found and returned
within 90 days of the declaration, less the processing charge, which is never
refunded. After 90 days the charge stands even if the item is returned.

A borrower may not substitute a personally purchased copy for a lost item; the
library orders replacements through its own supplier so that the record, the
barcode, and the processing match the rest of the collection.
